subject: Mathematics
title: Definite Integrals
summary: Definite integral ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx ek number hai — graph ke neeche ka signed area (x-axis ke upar +, neeche −). Fundamental theorem: antiderivative F nikaalo, phir F(b) − F(a).
JEE mein zyaadatar sawal seedhe integrate karne ke bajaye PROPERTIES se hote hain: King's property (x → a + b − x), odd/even, periodic, aur break-points par todna (|x|, [x]).
Integral ke andar upper limit variable ho to Leibniz rule se differentiate karo. 'Limit of a sum' wale sawal ko ∫₀¹ f(x) dx mein badlo.
Kuch standard results ratta maar lo: Wallis formula (sinⁿ, cosⁿ), ∫₀^{π/2} log sin x dx = −(π/2) log 2, aur ∫₀^{π/2} sinⁿx/(sinⁿx + cosⁿx) dx = π/4.

formulas.name: Fundamental theorem of calculus
formulas.formula: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = F(b) − F(a),   jahaan F′(x) = f(x)
formulas.mistake: Constant C cancel ho jaata hai — likhne ki zaroorat nahi.

formulas.name: Leibniz rule
formulas.formula: d/dx ∫_{g(x)}^{h(x)} f(t) dt = f(h(x)) h′(x) − f(g(x)) g′(x)
formulas.when: Limits mein x ho to derivative.
formulas.mistake: Andar ka x nahi, sirf limits par chain rule.

formulas.name: Dummy variable and reversing limits
formulas.formula: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = ∫ₐᵇ f(t) dt;   ∫ₐᵇ f = −∫_b^a f;   ∫ₐᵃ f = 0

formulas.name: Splitting the interval
formulas.mistake: Break-points (jahaan andar ka sign/value badle) par hi todo.

formulas.name: King's property
formulas.formula: ∫ₐᵇ f(x) dx = ∫ₐᵇ f(a + b − x) dx;   ∫₀ᵃ f(x) dx = ∫₀ᵃ f(a − x) dx
formulas.when: Jab x → (a + b − x) karne se expression 'pair' ban jaaye — I + I = 2I.
formulas.mistake: Original aur naya integral JODO, phir 2 se divide.

formulas.name: Property for 0 to 2a
formulas.formula: ∫₀^{2a} f = 2∫₀ᵃ f  agar f(2a − x) = f(x);   = 0  agar f(2a − x) = −f(x)
formulas.when: 0 se π ya 0 se 2π wale trig integrals.

formulas.name: Periodic functions
formulas.formula: f period T: ∫₀^{nT} f = n ∫₀ᵀ f;   ∫ₐ^{a+T} f = ∫₀ᵀ f
formulas.mistake: |sin x| ka period π hai, 2π nahi.

formulas.name: Wallis formula
formulas.formula: ∫₀^{π/2} sinⁿx dx = ∫₀^{π/2} cosⁿx dx = [(n−1)(n−3)…]/[n(n−2)…] × (π/2 agar n even, 1 agar n odd)

formulas.name: Standard results
formulas.formula: ∫₀^{π/2} log sin x dx = ∫₀^{π/2} log cos x dx = −(π/2) log 2;   ∫₀^{π/2} sinⁿx/(sinⁿx + cosⁿx) dx = π/4

formulas.name: Limit as a sum
formulas.formula: lim_{n→∞} (1/n) Σ_{r=1}^{n} f(r/n) = ∫₀¹ f(x) dx;   general: ∫ₐᵇ f = lim h Σ f(a + rh),  h = (b − a)/n
formulas.mistake: r/n → x, 1/n → dx. Agar r 0 se n tak ya 1 se 2n tak ho to limits badal jaati hain (2n tak → 0 se 2).

formulas.name: Substitution in definite integrals
formulas.formula: x = g(t) ⇒ dx = g′(t) dt aur limits bhi badlo: a → g⁻¹(a), b → g⁻¹(b)
formulas.mistake: Limits badal li to wapas x mein jaane ki zaroorat nahi.

formulas.name: Integration by parts (definite)
formulas.formula: ∫ₐᵇ u v′ dx = [u v]ₐᵇ − ∫ₐᵇ u′ v dx
formulas.when: Product wale integrals (x eˣ, x sin x, log x).

formulas.name: Bounds (estimation)
formulas.formula: m ≤ f ≤ M on [a, b] ⇒ m(b − a) ≤ ∫ₐᵇ f ≤ M(b − a);   |∫ f| ≤ ∫ |f|
formulas.when: 'Integral kis range mein hai' wale sawal.

examples.title: King's property (pair)
examples.problem: ∫₀^{π/2} sin x / (sin x + cos x) dx = ?
examples.solution: I = ∫ sin x/(sin x + cos x). x → π/2 − x: I = ∫ cos x/(cos x + sin x). Jodo: 2I = ∫₀^{π/2} 1 dx = π/2 ⇒ I = π/4.

examples.title: Odd function
examples.solution: f(−x) = (−x)³ cos(−x) = −x³ cos x ⇒ odd ⇒ integral = 0. Bina integrate kiye.

examples.title: King + odd-even mix
examples.solution: x → π − x: I = ∫ (π − x) sin x/(1 + cos²x). Jodo: 2I = π ∫₀^π sin x/(1 + cos²x) dx. t = cos x: = π ∫₋₁¹ dt/(1 + t²) = π × π/2 ⇒ I = π²/4.

examples.title: Limit as sum
examples.problem: lim_{n→∞} (1² + 2² + … + n²)/n³ aur lim_{n→∞} Σ_{r=1}^{n} n/(n² + r²) = ?
examples.solution: Pehla: (1/n) Σ (r/n)² → ∫₀¹ x² dx = 1/3.  Doosra: (1/n) Σ 1/(1 + (r/n)²) → ∫₀¹ dx/(1 + x²) = π/4.

examples.title: Log-sine standard result
examples.solution: I = ∫ log sin x = ∫ log cos x (King). 2I = ∫₀^{π/2} log(sin 2x / 2) dx = ∫ log sin 2x − (π/2) log 2. 2x = t se pehla hissa I ban jaata hai ⇒ 2I = I − (π/2) log 2 ⇒ I = −(π/2) log 2.

examples.title: By parts
examples.solution: u = x, v′ = eˣ: [x eˣ]₀¹ − ∫₀¹ eˣ dx = e − (e − 1) = 1.

topics.title: Definite integral ka matlab
topics.explain: Area under curve: chhote-chhote rectangles (width h, height f) ka sum, h → 0. Isliye 'limit of sum' aur integral ek hi cheez hain. x-axis ke neeche wala hissa negative gina jaata hai — asli area chahiye to |f| integrate karo.

topics.title: Property kab lagaye — quick checklist
topics.explain: 1) Limits −a se a? → odd/even check. 2) Limits 0 se a ya a se b, aur andar sin/cos ya x/(a+b−x) jaisa pair? → King. 3) Andar |…|, [x], {x}, max/min? → break-points par todo. 4) Periodic function aur bada interval? → period mein todo. 5) Limit of sum? → (1/n)Σ f(r/n).

topics.title: King's property ka asli use
topics.explain: Jab f(x) aur f(a + b − x) jod-ne par kuch simple bachta ho (jaise sin + cos, ya x + (π − x) = π). x wale factor ko hataane ke liye bhi (∫₀^π x f(sin x) dx = (π/2)∫₀^π f(sin x) dx).

topics.title: Leibniz rule ke uses
topics.explain: Limits mein x wale function ka derivative, maxima-minima, aur 'lim x→0 (∫₀ˣ …)/xⁿ' jaise 0/0 forms — L'Hospital + Leibniz saath mein.

topics.title: Limit as sum ko pehchaanna
topics.explain: Summation ko (1/n) × f(r/n) ki shakal mein likho: n bahar nikaalo. r ki range 1 se n ⇒ 0 se 1; 1 se 2n ⇒ 0 se 2; n+1 se 2n ⇒ 1 se 2.

topics.title: Substitution mein limits
topics.explain: Definite integral mein substitution karo to limits bhi naye variable mein badlo. Agar substitution one-one nahi (jaise t = sin x, 0 se π), to interval todna pad sakta hai.

topics.title: Area se connection
topics.explain: Do curves ke beech area = ∫ (upar wala − neeche wala) dx, intersection points ke beech. Ye agle chapter (Application of Integrals) ka base hai.

ratta: ∫₀^π x f(sin x) dx = (π/2) ∫₀^π f(sin x) dx.
